question: Chronological Threat scores in original posts mentioning Iran-related terms, independent of selected event windows.
eligibility: Original nonempty 2026 posts matching Iran/Iranian, Tehran, Hormuz, or Khamenei; no legacy-ID-only exceptions; no quote/reblog rows.
grain: One row per unique post; equal post weights within non-overlapping 14-day periods anchored February 28. Monthly summaries are also retained.
frame_prompt: military threats, escalation, retaliation, ultimatums, warnings, strikes, or destruction directed at Iran
candidate_labels: military threats, escalation, retaliation, ultimatums, warnings, strikes, or destruction directed at Iran
limitations: Entailment scores are uncalibrated and have no human accuracy evaluation.
Keywords and archived text omit posts that discuss Iran only through media or other words.
November is partial through November 3; no monthly interpolation or smoothing.
